trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression approximately 50 degrees wide, partially obscured by water spray and turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing edge of both lobes, visible against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory from the notch to the distal tips, showing a gradual upward arc in 2D space.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-intensity white pixel aggregates (barnacles) concentrated along the leading edge and scattered across the dorsal surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions indicating scratches visible on the dorsal surface of the left fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization along the leading edges; faint rake-mark scars on the mid-section of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a bird (seagull) in mid-flight partially occluding the right fluke lobe's trailing edge area.
